rows.grounds: second-person pronoun addressed to the being
vocative compound describing the being's appearance; bhīma+rūpa
fused form utthitaḥ+asi with sandhi; describes emergence
locative compound indicating place of emergence; jala+arṇava

items.question: What identity belongs to the fearsome being arisen from the ocean waters?
premises: The speakers directly address an unknown being.
The addressed being possesses a fearsome form.
The addressed being has arisen in the ocean waters.
items.inference: The speakers demand the identity of the fearsome being who emerged from the ocean.
items.plain_english: Who are you? Tell us, O fearsome-formed one—you who have risen in the ocean waters.
